description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Maintenance_Statistics_TestAndCorrect, which implements functions for testing and correcting statistical data in a database, including checking data ranges, removing duplicates, and updating inconsistent data in ad statistics tables.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance_Statistics_TestAndCorrect
classes.description: A class that provides methods to verify and correct ad statistics data in the database, including range checks, duplicate removal, and data synchronization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class by establishing a database connection.

methods.name: checkRangeData
methods.description: Checks if the data in the database within a date range is consistent, verifying operation intervals and start times of hourly data.

methods.name: issueOne
methods.description: Identifies and removes duplicate rows in ad statistics tables where data discrepancies are due to multiple summarizations.

methods.name: issueTwo
methods.description: Updates hourly ad statistics data to match intermediate data where discrepancies are due to missing or incomplete data.
